notes.title: The BIG update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024752/542245293cb3c1862dfe1a26c22ea6a9f4839e2a.png[/img]We’ve been away for a while, but for good reason! Our team has been working hard to push Project Hover toward a full release, and today, we’re excited to bring you our first major update!

Changelog :sparkles:
Content:
[list]
[*] 3 new hovers added
[*] New map: Favelas
[*] Updated part of the user interface
[*] 15 new languages added – making the game more accessible worldwide!
[*] 
[/list]
Fixes and Improvements:
[list]
[*] New physics model – for more realistic handling
[*] Enhanced network code – less lag, more excitement!
[*] Rebalanced all hovers – update your strategies!
[/list]

In Development:
[list]
[*] 3 new hovers
[*] 1 new track
[*] Additional UI improvements
[*] New mode: TakeHover – featuring unique online mode with hight stakes
[/list]

Known Issues (fixes in progress):
[list]
[*] Physics may behave incorrectly with high ping
[*] Incorrect landing of hovers after high jumps
[*] Tutorial is temporarily disabled – we’re working on improvements
[*] Reputation system is temporarily disabled until the TakeHover mode is released
[/list]


Thank you for playing Project Hover! :rocket: Leave your feedback – together we’ll make the game even better!
#ProjectHover #Update #RacingGame
